segments.name: Rare Disease Products
segments.description: Develops and commercializes rare disease pharmaceutical products, sold in the United States to specialty pharmacies for patients and their providers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates the business on the basis of a single reportable segment, which includes eight commercial rare disease products: INCRELEX®, ALKINDI SPRINKLE®, KHINDIVI TM , GALZIN®, PKU GOLIKE®, Carglumic Acid, Betaine Anhydrous, and Nitisinone.

revenueModel.text: Specialty pharmacy customers pay the company for product sales; those pharmacies then provide order fulfillment, inventory storage and distribution services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenues from product sales to specialty pharmacy customers, who then provide order fulfillment, inventory storage and distribution services.
